modelAtelier.name: Futuristic Humanoid · Articulated Hand Silhouette
modelAtelier.reference: Original one-piece organic-futuristic humanoid in T-pose. Four separate tapered fingertips and one opposable thumb per hand; continuous welded surface, refined athletic anatomy, six-island editable UVs and embedded original sci-fi PNG material. This is a modeling starter, not a skinned skeleton or rigged animation.
